source.text: All entries › Session Copy as Markdown Copied ← → Session You might say After signing in, why does the page stay signed in after refresh? State the server keeps for one person's continuous use, recognizing them by an identifier in a cookie·Remaining logged in after a page refresh happens because the browser automatically attaches a session cookie to every request, allowing the server to recognize the authenticated user. Once a session expires or gets cleared, the user must log in again—a lifecycle boundary rather than an authentication error.
